verdict.rationale: The evidence shows import support: OpenAPI import with tags mapped to folders, simultaneous import of collections and environments, and cURL import. It says nothing about exporting collections, so moving work out to other tools is unevidenced. Missing for 10: any evidence of collection export, a documented list of supported formats (e.g. Postman or Insomnia interchange), and independent or hands-on corroboration of round-trip portability.
